rules.title: Stateless handlers
rules.text: Keep handlers stateless and initialize clients outside the handler for reuse.

rules.title: Small packages
rules.text: Keep deployment packages small to reduce cold starts.

rules.title: Timeouts and retries
rules.text: Set timeouts below the caller timeout and design for duplicate invocations.

rules.title: One role per function
rules.text: Give each function its own minimal role.

rules.title: Avoid recursive invocations
rules.text: Avoid designs where a function triggers itself; if it happens, set reserved concurrency to 0 to stop the loop while you fix the code.
